hooks.command: [ -n "$LANTERN_SPIKE_URL" ] || exit 0; i=$(cat); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -c '{hook_event_name,session_id}'); else p=$(printf '%s' "$i" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(json.dumps({"hook_event_name":d.get("hook_event_name"),"session_id":d.get("session_id")}))'); fi; curl -sS -m 3 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$p" "$LANTERN_SPIKE_URL/hook" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
